bio.text: James Talarico, a Democrat, represents a district in the Texas House and won the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in the March 2026 primary, according to the Associated Press.
He was first elected to the Texas House in 2018. He was born in Round Rock, earned degrees from the University of Texas at Austin and Harvard University, and taught middle school in San Antonio.
According to his campaign website, he is an eighth-generation Texan and a Presbyterian seminarian.
